description: This file defines classes and functions for managing a browser instance and contexts using the BiDi protocol in Playwright, including connection setup, event handling, context and page management, and network settings.

classes.name: BidiBrowser
classes.description: Represents a browser instance managed via the BiDi protocol, handling connection, contexts, and pages.

classes.name: BidiBrowserContext
classes.description: Represents a browser context in BiDi, managing cookies, permissions, geolocation, and scripts.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a new BidiBrowser connection, initializes session, and creates default context and page if persistent.

methods.name: doCreateNewContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with specified options.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextCreated
methods.description: Handles creation of new browsing contexts and pages.

methods.name: _onBrowsingContextDestroyed
methods.description: Handles destruction of browsing contexts and pages.

methods.name: setGeolocation
methods.description: Sets geolocation for the browser context.
